cards.title: Being a Working Parent is a Logistical Nightmare
cards.body: Working parents struggle to balance school hours with work schedules, creating constant time management challenges. Emily Mulligan explores how school holidays could become quality family time rather than another logistics puzzle.

cards.title: Play School is Back – Quality TV for Toddlers
cards.body: This children's program offers parents a guilt-free screen time option that doesn't overstimulate young viewers. Natalie Morris celebrates finding TV she's actually happy for her toddler to watch.

cards.title: The Secret Codeword for Sleepover Safety
cards.body: A simple codeword can help children safely signal distress during sleepovers without alerting others around them. Polly Hudson recommends this practical strategy for parents worried about their child's wellbeing away from home.

cards.title: Splitting Domestic Load Prevents Parental Burnout
cards.body: An unequal division of household and childcare duties puts enormous strain on relationships and parental wellbeing. Experts discuss how couples can redistribute the mental load more fairly.

cards.title: Whose Job is It to Empty the Dishwasher?
cards.body: Unbalanced domestic responsibilities often fall heavily on women, creating stress and burnout risk in families. Experts explain essential conversations couples need to have about household duties.
